message.content:
{
 "summary": "Blower B-301 raised a high discrepancy alarm at 10:00 as it was commanded on but is not running, with blower power JT-301 dropping to zero and dissolved oxygen AIT-301 falling to 0.00 mg/L. The most likely root cause is a blower motor overload trip, VFD fault, loss of motor supply, high discharge pressure, closed air valve, belt failure, or high bearing temperature shutdown.",
 "likely_causes": [
  "Blower motor overload trip, VFD fault, or loss of the motor supply",
  "High discharge pressure (diffuser fouling) or a closed air valve",
  "Belt failure, or a high bearing temperature shutdown"
 ],
 "checks": [
  "Check the VFD display and the motor control centre for the trip reason",
  "Check the blower discharge pressure and the air valve positions",
  "Look and listen for belt or bearing damage before any restart",
  "If the blower is actually running, confirm the DO probe reading with the portable DO meter"
 ],
 "handover": "Blower B-301 tripped at 10:00, resulting in dissolved oxygen AIT-301 dropping to 0.00 mg/L and power JT-301 dropping to zero while speed command SC-301 is at 100 %. Pending restoration of B-301, monitor aeration status and coordinate with the control room to start the standby blower.",
 "citations": [
  "SOP-06 6.2",
  "SOP-06 6.3",
  "SOP-06 6.4",
  "SOP-06 6.5"
 ]
}
